senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. גָּרָה) [to produce a grating, scraping sound,]
to scratch, scrape, shave (v. גָּרַד, גָּרַע I).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 8:6">Sabb. VIII, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 81a:1">81ᵃ</cite>) <he>כדי לִגְרוֹר וכ׳</he> (Ar. a. Y. ed. <he>לגרוד</he>) large enough to scrape with it the top &c.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 27b">R. Hash. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>גְּרָרוֹ</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>גרדו</he>), v. <cite ref="C00879"><he>גֶּלֶד</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Ketubot 60a">Keth. 60ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Keritot 21b:47">Kerith. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>גּוֹרְרוֹ וכ׳</he> he must scrape the blood off before eating the bread; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="C01314"><he>גָּרוּר</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="C01293"><he>גָּרוּד</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to drag, to move without lifting; (also neut. verb) to follow.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 29b:8">Sabb. 29ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>גורר אדם וכ׳</he> one may, on the Sabbath, pull or push a couch &c. (on the floor).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 1:9:3">Y. Kil. I, 27ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>לא יָגוֹר אדם וכ׳</he> one must not pull &c. Tanḥ. Thazr. 8 <he>גְּרָרוּהוּ מקברו</he> they dragged him out of his grave. Tosef. Erub. XI (VIII), 13; <cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 2:19">Tosef. Bets. II, 19</cite> <he>דלת הגּוֹרֶרֶת … הגּוֹרְרִים</he> (<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 10:8:4">Y. Erub. X, 26ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>גודרת</he>, corr. acc., v. <cite ref="C00244"><he>גָּדַר</he></cite>) a door which drags along the ground (on opening), a matting which is moved by dragging, or large kegs which &c.; <cite ref="Eruvin 101a:2">Erub. 101ᵃ</cite> <he>דלת הנִגְרֶרֶת … הנִגְרָר</he>.

Cant. R. to II, 15 אני גוֹרְרוֹ למבולו I will drag him to the flood in which to perish; a. fr.—Tanḥ. Thazr. 9 (ref. to Ps. V, 5 יגרך) אין אתה נגרר … ואין הרעה גוֹרֶרֶת אותך וכ׳ neither art thou dragged behind (attracted by) evil, nor does evil drag (have power over) thee, nor does it dwell with thee; Yalk. Kings 231 אין אתה גורר אחר … גוררת אחריך.—Part. pass. גָּרוּר dragged along, hanging on.—Pl. גְּרוּרִים, גְּרוּרִין.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18:21">Num. R. s. 18</cite> <he>ח׳ ג׳</he> eight threads dragged along (as fringes; Tanḥ. Korah 12 <he>ח׳ חוטין</he>).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 3b:4">Ab. Zar. 3ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>גרים ג׳</he> proselytes who have attached themselves but have not been admitted, v. <cite ref="C01225"><he>גֵּר</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to carry with it, to cause; to affect (v. גָּרַם).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Horayot 1:6:2">Y. Hor. I, 46ᵃ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 7:6:2">Y. Pes. VII, 34ᶜ</cite> <he>שבט אחד גּוֹרֵר וכ׳</he> (a majority of) one tribe affects the legal status of the entire nation, i.e. the majority of tribes (seven) decides, though it may be a minority of the people as a whole.
Lev. R. s. 13, end (play on gerah, Lev. XI, 4 sq.) גָּרְרָה מלכות וכ׳ carried another government after it, i.e. was followed by another oppressive government.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:2">Ab. IV, 2</cite> <he>מצוה גוֹרֶרֶת וכ׳</he> a good deed begets a good deed &c.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 15:6">Tosef. Sabb. XV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 16:6">XVI</cite>), 6 [read:] <he>אין גּוֹרֵר וכ׳</he> it is not considered a corpse so as to cause uncleanness to man or vessels.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 17:2">Sabb. XVII, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 122b">122ᵇ</cite>) a saw (may be used on the Sabbath) <he>לָגוֹר בה וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>לִגְרוֹר</he>, Mish. ed. Pes. <he>לגָרֵר</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) to saw cheese with it. Ohol. XV, 8 <he>עתיד לָגוֹר</he> Ar. intended to be sawed apart (ed. <he>לגוד</he>, fr. <cite ref="C00166"><he>גדד</he></cite>, v. Tosef. ib. XV, 8).
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 2:18">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 18</cite> <he>לָגוֹר וכ׳</he> to saw off a part &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 10:11">Erub. X, 11</cite> <he>נגר הנג׳</he> a bolt which is dragged along (with the door, i.e. attached and hanging down).
<cite ref="Eruvin 101a">Ib. 101ᵃ</cite>, v. supra. Tanḥ. Thazr. 9, v. supra.
<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 2:10">Bets. II, 10</cite> (<cite ref="Beitzah 23b:3">23ᵇ</cite>) <he>אינה נִגְרֶרֶת</he>; Bets. <he>אין נִגְרָרִין</he> must not be dragged or pulled, a. fr.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 119b">B. Kam. 119ᵇ</cite> <he>הנ׳ במגירה</he> shavings, opp. <he>נפסק במגירה</he> chips.—
<cite ref="Niddah 55b:38">Nidd. 55ᵇ</cite> <he>נִגְרָרִין דרך הפה</he> (secretions of the nose) scraped (discharged) through the mouth (v. <cite ref="C01388"><he>גָּרַף</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 4:9">Pes. IV, 9</cite> (<cite ref="Pesachim 56a:2">56ᵃ</cite>) <he>ג׳ עצמות וכ׳</he> he had the bones of his father carried out on a bed of ropes.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 1:2">Pes. I, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Pesachim 9a">9ᵃ</cite>); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 6:1">Tosef. Sabb. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 7:1">VII</cite>), 1 (a superstitious custom) <he>המְגָרֶרֶת בנה וכ׳</he> Var. (ed. Zuck. <he>המגוררת</he>) one who drags her son among the dead (to the cemetery).

senses.gloss: to scrape, plane. Ib. XVI (XVII), 19 מְגָרְרָן he may scrape them (clean his feet of mud).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 2:17">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 17</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 25a:13">Ḥull. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>עתיד … לגָרֵר</he> requiring planing for finish; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְגוֹרָר</he>
Gen. R. s. 64 (play on מגרר, Gen. XXVI, 26) ד״א מג׳ וכ׳ another explanation is m’gorar, for eruptions grew on him (with ref. to Job II, 8); Yalk. ib. 111; v. גָּרַר II.
senses.label: a

units: <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 15:1">Tosef. Sot. XV, 1</cite> <he>מְגוֹרָרוֹת במגר׳ היו</he> Var. (ed. Zuck. <he>היה מְגָרֵר</he>) the stones were planed with a plane.
senses.label: b

units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 16:8">Tosef. Sabb. XVI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 17:19">XVII</cite>), 19 <he>אין מִתְגָּרְרִין במגוררת</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>מגרדין במגרדת</he>, <cite ref="Shabbat 147b:13">Sabb. 147ᵇ</cite> <he>גוררין במגררת</he>, Ms. M. <he>גודרין במגדירה</he>, corr. acc.) one must not be scraped with a strigil. Ib. XXII, 6 (147ᵃ) <he>מתגררין</he>, Talm. ed. (Mish. <he>מִתְגָּרְדִין</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. to 147ᵇ, note 70).
